name: Ines Okonkwo-Hale

statedReqs.notes: One of three partners who bought the old mill dormitory together. The other two want out by spring, and she is the one who answers the phone.

hiddenPrefs.desc: The partnership agreement lets the other two force a sale to the highest bidder if she cannot clear 93% of their number. She will not sign under that.

intro: Twelve apartments in a brick dormitory the mill built for its weavers. She has the partnership's spreadsheet open on her phone before she sits down, and she has already divided it by a cap rate she read in a newsletter.

commercial.rentRoll: Twelve one-bedrooms on yearly leases, a third of them turning over in the summer when the college lets out. One unit has been the same retired loom-fixer since 1994.

issues.desc: Hallway carpet and the laundry room's two dryers at the end of their life
The boiler's heat exchanger is cracked and the 1960s risers weep at three joints
An abandoned heating-oil tank under the side lot, never pulled when the building went to gas
